caption: The drawing depicts a single object set against a plain, light beige background. The object appears to be a stylized, ornate piece of metalwork rendered in shades of brown, reddish-brown, and hints of darker brown. The left side of the object is broader, featuring a forked, three-pronged shape with slightly curved tips, resembling an abstract or zoomorphic design. Extending rightward from the wide end, the object transitions into a narrower, elongated segment that is intricately patterned with openwork scrolls, interlocking loops, and curved forms creating a network of negative spaces. The object maintains a three-dimensional appearance through shading that suggests volume and depth. The word "COPY HOLLINGSWORTH" is printed in small letters to the lower right of the object. There are no additional objects, figures, or elements in the composition.
title: Bootjack
